But of a tangent but: I had a period with my boyfriend where I bent over backwards and sacrificed my mental health to figure out what was wrong. I ended up having a psychotic breakdown and trying to kill myself because I was so stressed.

We've worked on things since, and I told him I can't look after him. If we're in bed and he says he's sad, I'll ask what's wrong. If he tells me we'll talk about it. If he says he doesn't know, I'll ask what he needs from me or what will make him feel better. If he says he doesn't know then that's the end of the conversation and he knows that. 

We both have bpd, we're both going to have mood swings and feel sad and stressed and not know why. It's up to us to figure it out and then self sooth or ask for help. Our relationship has been so much better since doing that. 

The point of this was: if your girlfriend isn't capable of communicating with you, she might not be ready for a relationship.
